summary: This class models the Add Device page in the HPX Rebranding flow for Windows automation testing. It extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides comprehensive methods for verifying UI elements, performing user actions (clicks, text input), and validating the add device workflow. The class follows a clear pattern of separating verification methods (verify_*) from action methods (click_*, input_*, get_*). It uses string-based locator identifiers that are resolved by the underlying driver framework. Notable patterns include configurable timeouts, optional exception raising for element verification, and methods for interacting with external applications like Microsoft Store. The class supports device addition workflows including serial number search, product number input, and HP Smart app integration.
